messages:
sasha: heads-up: after upgrading to python-sdk 0.9.0 our strict-mypy job started failing with errors from autogenerated models.

kyle: can you paste one of the errors?

sasha: sure:

```
services/checkout/client.py:52: error: Expression of type "str" cannot be assigned to declared type "Optional[str]"  [assignment]
Found 1 error in 1 file (checked 40 source files)
```

sasha: client does `order.title = resp['title']` where generated model has `title: Optional[str] = None`. previously responses were TypedDicts so this didn't show up.

sergio: we moved domain objects to pydantic. we didn't emit typed response stubs, so assignments from Mapping[str, Any] hit strict checkers. options: re-emit TypedDicts, widen fields, add type ignores, or add an opt-in generator flag.

kyle: widening or ignores are bandaids. prefer an opt-in `--typed-responses` CLI flag so teams can adopt gradually.

sasha: agree. also noticed embedding arrays are `List[Any]`. can we use `List[float]` when schema items are numbers?

sergio: yes, we'll add heuristics (number -> float, integer -> int). i'll prototype `--typed-responses` and a small async sample that consumes TypedDict responses with AsyncClient. will also add a mypy.ini and pyrightconfig.json example.

devx-bot: branch pushed: feature/typed-responses (repo: python-sdk)

kyle: also request: include `from __future__ import annotations` at top of generated files to avoid forward-ref noise.

sasha: interim workaround: `from typing import cast, Optional` then `order.title = cast(Optional[str], resp.get('title'))` — ugly, but unblocks CI until SDK patch.

sergio: thanks. i'll open a WIP PR with the flag, async sample, and a tiny mypy+pyright test. ETA EOD PST. ping here when it's up. :thumbsup:
